seal.statement: Every fallback site the detector module reports (two-source reads, typeof dual paths, catch-and-default) has a census record in data/fallback-census/census.json: the site's file, range and content hash, the class derived from V8 block coverage collected with NODE_V8_COVERAGE over the unit, packaging, integration and bootstrap corpus and one fresh-formation scenario (never, primary-only, fallback-only, both, or unloaded when no run loaded the file), and the identity of every run that contributed; the census is produced by one script under scripts/checks that merges the per-process coverage files and joins them to the detector sites, so that the budget row fallback_sites_uncensused reads zero at the head the census was taken on.

text: Fable verifier (read-only; verify-census/verdict.md; staged tree 83440ebde92083c082e637a904998425c716e09a3443e2580cdc8d5bd3eb03e4 at HEAD 67e0bba0e): REJECT. Holds: V8 block-coverage innermost-range semantics (fixtures), side mapping for all three rows verified end to end with REAL coverage (V8 emits a zero-count range for a skipped || / ?? right operand, separate ranges for conditional/else/catch bodies; fallback-only is structurally impossible for two_source and catch rows), hash binding and identity 2803 records = 2803 detector sites with 0 duplicates and 0 mismatches, runs per record exact, formation rerun bound to identical src digests with the seed's SIGTERM flush present, join reproduces the committed census byte-for-byte, R27 (join/report write only the census), gates and 7/8 mutants killed (the preload re-raise mutant hangs instead of failing). Rejects: B1 the classes never (158), primary-only (1201) and fallback-only (41) rest on runs marked complete that lost processes whose coverage could show the other side executing - the unit lane's write-identity-instance test died by SIGABRT (closure 1067 src files, 730 non-both sites), four integration tests SIGKILL their children by design (closures up to 1620 files, 1160 non-both sites), the formation seed's worker threads wrote nothing, and the four corpus lanes ran without the flush preload; the pipeline has no process accounting, so 'never' measures 'no surviving coverage file shows the side', an acquittal under the epic's own rule. B2 runs-are-named is met in letter only: one aggregated sidesExecuted per record, so the record cannot say whether the fallback ran under the formation. Non-blocking: unloaded also encodes 'incomplete run saw less than both' (R07), preload-less runs carry no coveragePreload field, fallback-only structurally 0 for two rows (record in the epic), the re-raise mutant hangs in the test, Windows URLs drop silently, the four lanes' commit is a WIP snapshot (file digests are the binding). Lead decision: repair at the pipeline (witness markers per process and thread, periodic coverage flushes, lost-witness detection in merge, a distinct named class unobserved for sites in a lost witness's import closure that the budget keeps counting as uncensused, per-run sides) and re-collect all five lanes; the residual unobserved count by cause goes to the owner as the decision point between eliminating the losses and a targeted re-observation rule before any deletion.

Account for missing census participants independently of self-reporting via launch-owner expected-participant rosters (roster-<pid>-<threadId>.json in fallback-branch-census-witnesses.js, fallback-branch-census-preload.js, fallback-branch-census.js, formation-health.js, and run-test-files.js), close the eval-Worker and stripped-preload blind spots so uninstrumented or no-coverage participants remain unobserved, tighten readClassifiedIdentities in code-navigability-budget.js, and update epic/quest contracts to require sole-owner semantic proof (including primary-only sites) before retirement.

Independently verified launch-owner expected-participant roster recording, accountWitnesses reconciliation against start/exit/coverage files, eval-Worker and stripped-preload unobserved accounting, tightened classification validator in code-navigability-budget.js, and updated epic/quest semantic retirement contracts; 21/21 fallback-branch-census.test.js and 17/17 code-navigability-budget.test.js pass.

Extended lostClosureFiles with hasUnboundedClosure so uninstrumented, eval-worker, empty-reachedSrc, or dynamic-import lost runs void all src/ acquittals to unobserved; wrapped execFileSync in fallback-branch-census-preload.js and runLaneProcess in fallback-branch-census.js to record expected node processes in the parent roster; indexed coverageWriters in fallback-branch-census-witnesses.js so markerless coverage files are accounted as lost uninstrumented witnesses; hardened code-navigability-budget.js to require all 5 REQUIRED_CENSUS_LANES, non-blank ownerQuest and review, and disposition for primary-only sites.

Independent adversarial re-verification replayed all four census counterexamples (uninstrumented child executing dynamically imported fallback, execFileSync launch with stripped env, coverage file without start/end/roster markers, and classification validator with missing lanes / blank ownerQuest or review / unclassified primary-only sites) and confirmed every case fails closed with 38/38 script test assertions and all static ratchets passing.

Owner decisions 2026-11-08 20:15 CET. (A) Residual rule: ELIMINATE the coverage losses rather than accept an unobserved class: flush coverage just before the deliberate kills in the process-loss harness tests (apparatus only, kill semantics unchanged), give the formation seed a drain window in census mode, route the SIGABRT of test/query/write-identity-instance.test.js to the query owner; then re-collect all five lanes. The unobserved class stays as the honest accounting of any residual loss, never as a licence to delete. (B) Ownership: this quest stays with the epic lead's agents. The concurrent attempts 'roster-reconciled-witnesses' (17:45Z) and 'hasUnboundedClosure' (19:28Z) with approving verifications by subagent:28f0c4b0-0750-42c1-8399-acafa8f56424 were recorded by the owner's other agent system without coordination; by owner decision that work is not part of this quest's candidate (its edits are preserved as a patch outside the repository) and those entries do not verify this candidate. Collection 4 (snapshot refs/wip/nav-census-collect-4 = 1968c3e5e) measured 2803 sites: never 15, primary-only 78, fallback-only 2, both 1401, unobserved 1307 from 40 lost witnesses (12 deliberate-kill integration mains + 12 of their piscina workers, the formation seed SIGKILLed after its drain overran the demo stop deadline, 1 SIGABRT unit test, 14 fixture copies outside the root with empty closures).

Round 3: coverage losses eliminated per owner decision (census-mode pre-kill flush via SIGURG preload + harness flushCoverageBeforeKill, piscina atomics off in census mode, formation demo stop deadline override 300 s in census mode only, test heap raised in census mode for the OOM-in-coverage-write SIGABRT, external class for out-of-repo fixture copies); collection 5 on tv-dator (snapshot 75e049e5f): 2803 sites never 162 / primary-only 1201 / fallback-only 41 / both 1399 / unobserved 0; probe 0.

Independent verification (Opus, scratchpad/verify-census-r3/verdict.md): REJECT, 2 blocking, 7 non-blocking. Holds: re-merge and re-join of collection 5 reproduce the staged census exactly; witness counts reconcile; 20 sampled never/fallback-only sites re-derived from raw V8 agree; lost hangs.fixture voids 0; demo deadline default unchanged; gates green; mutations of SIGURG flush, ack-without-flush, harness no-op, lost-unless-acked, non-final ack, worker-without-main-ack each killed. B1: a process that dies after writing its end marker (exit listener) but before the final coverage write is counted complete and its sites acquitted; completion must also require a coverage file written at or after the end marker. B2: four guards without a killing witness: the post-final-flush freeze (main and worker), the entry check of the external rule (in-repo entry with out-of-repo cwd becomes external), node -e with out-of-repo cwd, the harness env gate (existing test uses pid 1). Non-blocking N1 preload-dropping processes outside the accounting (document), N2 SIGABRT routing deviation from the owner decision must be logged, N3 hold timer runs outside census mode, N4 epic bullet stale counts, N5 markers polluted by Object.prototype.toJSON, N6, N7.

Lead note on N2: the SIGABRT was diagnosed as a V8 out-of-memory in the coverage write under the runner's 512 MB test heap cap, reproduced by the verifier (abort at 512 MB, pass at 2048 MB); it is apparatus, not a query-owner src defect, so the owner decision's routing to the query owner is superseded by this diagnosis; the census-mode heap raise is the repair.

Round 4 (repair after REJECT): an end marker completes a thread only with a coverage file of that thread written at or after it (name-ms vs marker at; mtime fallback for markers without at; new lost cause final-write-missing; workers completed via main exit need the main complete); witnesses for the post-flush freeze (main and worker), the external rule's entry check and node -e cwd, the harness env gate with a live child; markers serialised from own primitives with intrinsics captured at preload (N5); N1 documented; N3 notes corrected; N4 epic counts corrected; 26/26 mutations killed; re-merge and re-join of collection 5 identical to the staged census.json.

Delta verification of round 4 (Opus, scratchpad/verify-census-r4/verdict.md): APPROVE, 0 blocking, 4 non-blocking. B1 holds (round-3 experiment with external SIGKILL now lost with final-write-missing, site unobserved); name-ms comparison sound, mtime fallback strict; 26/26 implementer mutations killed plus 4 of 6 verifier mutations killed; B2 witnesses non-vacuous; N5 robust against patched intrinsics; re-merge and re-join of collection 5 identical (never 162, primary-only 1201, fallback-only 41, both 1399, unobserved 0); SIGABRT routing decision logged; census tests 33/33, pre-commit 0, duplication, probe 0. Non-blocking: N-a millisecond-wait witness is timing-dependent (MG2 killed 4/6), N-b Object.keys capture unwitnessed, N-c mtime-preservation assumption documented not checked, N-d backward wall-clock step theoretical.

Altitude check after four attempts (two of them the other agent system's roster attempts, ruled out of this quest): the rejections were not one root recurring at a lower level. Round 1 was rejected for acquitting lost processes and missing per-run sides (accounting model); the owner then chose to eliminate losses rather than accept a residual (round 3, a different mechanism: pre-kill flush, demo deadline, heap); round 3's rejection was two narrow accounting gaps in that new mechanism (end marker before the final write; unwitnessed guards), repaired in round 4 and approved. The altitude is right: the census is apparatus measuring coverage, the losses were eliminated at their causes, and residual risk (preload-dropping processes, mtime-preserving copies) is documented, not hidden.
